title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.8.4 is the review follow-up release of the complete 43-notebook, 26-lecture CFD-to-scientific-machine-learning course. It restores the axis label that the v1.8.3 figure repair removed from the six Week 15 comparison figures, refreshes their SHA-256 provenance, re-executes the Week 15 flagship notebook and rebuilds its lecture, adds a glossary, defines the quarantined g005 geometry, unifies the Week 9 lab labels, records the CI regeneration of the family-holdout evidence, and gives the CUDA-only Track 6 notebook a clear stop on CPU machines. The scientific results and the frozen Week 15 evidence archives are unchanged; no new CFD or model training is claimed.
